<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915585_theRebbe_828__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening heading and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">19 Kislev 5715*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the levels from Atzmus Ein Sof to the ten Sefiros of Atzilus as enumerated in the introduction to Tikkunei Zohar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Eliyahu opened and said,</t>
    <t s="1">"Master of the worlds, You are One and not in number,</t>
    <t s="2">You are the highest above all high,</t>
    <t s="3">the hidden above all hidden,</t>
    <t s="4">no thought can grasp You at all,</t>
    <t s="5">You are He who brought forth ten adornments which we call the ten Sefiros."</t>
    <t s="6">And it is explained by my father-in-law, the Rebbe, in his maamar beginning with the word "Zeh"</t>
    <t s="7">which he said on 19 Kislev</t>
    <t s="8">(5712),</t>
    <t s="9">that all the levels from the Essence of Ein Sof to the ten Sefiros of Atzilus are enumerated here.</t>
    <t s="10">"You are One" is the Essence of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="11">and in Keter it is the innerness of Keter,</t>
    <t s="12">Atik.</t>
    <t s="13">And regarding this level it says "and not in number,"</t>
    <t s="14">that it is not in the number of the matters enumerated afterwards,</t>
    <t s="15">for all the matters enumerated afterwards</t>
    <t s="16">(including also "the highest above all high")</t>
    <t s="17">are incomparable relative to "You are One,"</t>
    <t s="18">therefore it is not counted with them,</t>
    <t s="19">not in number.</t>
    <t s="20">"You are the highest above all high" is the externality of Keter,</t>
    <t s="21">Arich.</t>
    <t s="22">"The hidden above all hidden" is the Chochmah of Arich.</t>
    <t s="23">"No thought can grasp You at all" is the innerness of Chochmah.</t>
    <t s="24">"You are He who brought forth ten adornments,"</t>
    <t s="25">they are the ten Sefiros of Atzilus.</t>
    <t s="26">And it explains,</t>
    <t s="27">that the reason that in Atzilus the Sefiros are in number</t>
    <t s="28">(ten adornments)</t>
    <t s="29">is,</t>
    <t s="30">because Atzilus is included in the order of Hishtalshelus</t>
    <t s="31">(limitation),</t>
    <t s="32">and in Hishtalshelus the concept of number applies.</t>
    <t s="33">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="34">that the matters enumerated here are divided generally into three categories.</t>
    <t s="35">"You are One" which refers</t>
    <t s="36">(as above)</t>
    <t s="37">to Atik,</t>
    <t s="38">is removed and separate from Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="39">"You are the highest above all high,"</t>
    <t s="40">which is above Hishtalshelus but relates to Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="41">"You are He who brought forth ten adornments,"</t>
    <t s="42">they are the ten Sefiros of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="43">Hishtalshelus.</t>
    <t s="44">And it continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="45">that through the service of mesirus nefesh they draw down from the level of "You are One" into the ten Sefiros.</t>
    <t s="46">And through this the revelation of that which is above nature is drawn into nature.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the levels above the ten Sefiros are above nature, and questions why a revelation above nature is needed within nature.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, from that which it says in the maamar of "Patah Eliyahu" — "You are He who brought forth ten adornments... to conduct the worlds through them,"</t>
    <t s="2">that the reason for the emanation of the ten Sefiros of Atzilus is so that through them there will be the conduct of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="3">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="4">that the levels above the ten Sefiros are above the conduct of the worlds.</t>
    <t s="5">Accordingly,</t>
    <t s="6">also the revelation of "You are the highest" etc. is above nature.</t>
    <t s="7">And in the maamar it says that the drawing down of the revelation that is above nature is through the drawing down from the level of "You are One."</t>
    <t s="8">It also needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="9">that since the conduct of the world according to nature is that Ein Sof conducts the world in this manner,</t>
    <t s="10">"You are He who brought forth ten adornments... to conduct the worlds through them,"</t>
    <t s="11">why is it necessary that within nature there be the drawing down of the revelation that is above nature?</t>
    <t s="12">And although that which Ein Sof conducts the worlds through the ten Sefiros is through His enclothing in the vessels of the ten Sefiros</t>
    <t s="13">[for the conduct of the worlds is from the light that is enclothed in the worlds,</t>
    <t s="14">and in order for the light to be enclothed in the worlds it is through being enclothed</t>
    <t s="15">(first)</t>
    <t s="16">in the vessels],</t>
    <t s="17">nevertheless, even after the light is enclothed in the vessels and in the worlds, it is connected with Ein Sof, Who has no end.</t>
    <t s="18">And as explained in the continuation of 5666</t>
    <t s="19">that this that in the conduct of nature there is the matter of constancy</t>
    <t s="20">(although nature is from the Divine vitality that is enclothed in the creations,</t>
    <t s="21">which is limited vitality),</t>
    <t s="22">is,</t>
    <t s="23">because the source of the vitality that is enclothed in the creations is from the light of the line,</t>
    <t s="24">whose source is from Ein Sof before the tzimtzum,</t>
    <t s="25">and the perfection of nature is through the revelation of that which is above nature being drawn into it.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
